func inOrder<T>(_ items: [T], _ step: (T) async throws -> Void, reason: String) async throws {
  for item in items {
    consume(

      try await step(item),

      "plain await \(try await step(item))"
    )
  }
}
func inOrderSteps(_ steps: [() async -> Void], reason: String) async {
  for step in steps { consume("plain await \(await step())") }
}
